chemistry-killer-08.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-killer-08.material: Dhangala'aa soodiyeemii haayidirooksaayidii ($\mathrm{NaOH}$, ulfaatina foormulaa 40) 20 % (dhibbeentaa ulfaatinaa) cuunfaan isaa 1.2 g/mL dha. Dhangala'aa kana bishaaniin laaffisuun dhangala'aa NaOH 0.5 M 600 mL hojjechuuf yoo barbaadne, bal'inni dhangala'aa NaOH 20 % barbaachisu (mL) meeqa? (Ulfaatina atomii H=1, O=16, Na=23. Koncentireeshinii moolaarii $M = \frac{10xd}{M_w}$, x dhibbeentaa ulfaatinaa, d cuunfaa dhangala'aa g/mL)
chemistry-killer-08.s.s1.prompt: Dhangala'aa soodiyeemii haayidirooksaayidii ($\mathrm{NaOH}$, ulfaatina foormulaa 40) 20 % (dhibbeentaa ulfaatinaa) cuunfaan isaa 1.2 g/mL dha. Dhangala'aa kana bishaaniin laaffisuun dhangala'aa NaOH 0.5 M 600 mL hojjechuuf yoo barbaadne, bal'inni dhangala'aa NaOH 20 % barbaachisu (mL) meeqa? (Ulfaatina atomii H=1, O=16, Na=23. Koncentireeshinii moolaarii $M = \frac{10xd}{M_w}$, x dhibbeentaa ulfaatinaa, d cuunfaa dhangala'aa g/mL)
chemistry-killer-08.s.s1.explain:
Tarkaanfii 1: Koncentireeshinii moolaarii NaOH 20 % $M = \frac{10 \times 20 \times 1.2}{40} = 6.0$ mol/L (1 L = dhangala'aa 1200 g keessaa NaOH 240 g = 6 mol).
Tarkaanfii 2: Moolii wanta furmaatu dhangala'aa hojjetamuu = 0.5 mol/L × 0.600 L = 0.30 mol (NaOH 12 g).
Tarkaanfii 3: Laaffisuu keessatti moolii wanta furmaatu kan murtaa'e: 6.0 × V = 0.30 → V = 0.050 L = 50 mL. (Mirkaneessa: 12 g ÷ 0.20 = dhangala'aa 60 g, 60 g ÷ 1.2 g/mL = 50 mL)
Deebii: 50 mL (d). (Deebii dogoggoraa: 60 mL cuunfaa tuffachuun M = 5.0 jedhee lakkaa'uu dha, 72 mL 60 g cuunfaadhaan baay'isuu dha, 5.0 mL dogoggora lakkoofsaa dha)
chemistry-killer-08.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
chemistry-killer-08.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
